_comment: Allowlisted GitHub repos whose images may be harvested. Every entry MUST declare the repo's license and how filenames map to label_schema classes. Repos without a license (or with a mismatched one) are refused unless --ignore-license is passed. label_map keys are filename prefixes; files matching skip_prefixes are counted but never downloaded/labelled (kept for the separate tasks they belong to).

repos.why: Authente-Kente paper reference app (MIT). app/raw/real_*.jpg are 8 museum/private-collection kente photos used as demo inputs.
repos.skip_note: fake_* swatches are machine-made imitations for the authenticity task — never merged into category labels (tools/dataset/README honesty rules)

repos.why: Authente-Kente monorepo (MIT). One real kente sample image in notebooks.
